t.t: How Noel's Pharmacy handles personal, order and prescription request information.

div.p: This policy explains how Noel's Pharmacy & Wellness Center Ltd. collects and uses information submitted through this website. It should be reviewed by the company before the website is published.
We may collect account details, contact information, order and payment status, delivery information, website communications, and information or files submitted with prescription requests.
Information is used to operate the online store, process orders, review prescription requests, communicate with customers, provide support, maintain records, prevent misuse and improve service.

Prescription uploads can contain sensitive health information. Access is limited to authorised personnel who need it to review and fulfil the request. Uploading a prescription does not guarantee approval or fulfilment.

Payments, hosting, email, delivery and other functions may be processed through configured service providers. Those providers handle information needed to perform their services under their own terms and safeguards.

Records are retained only as needed for service, operational, professional and applicable record-keeping purposes. Reasonable administrative and technical safeguards are used, but no online system can guarantee absolute security.
You may contact Noel's to ask about personal information associated with you, request corrections, or raise a privacy concern, subject to identity verification and any records that must be retained.
Privacy questions may be submitted through the contact page or by calling .

t.t: Website, online order and prescription request terms for Noel's Pharmacy.
Clear terms for a clear experience.

div.p: These terms govern use of the Noel's Pharmacy & Wellness Center Ltd. website. They should be reviewed by the company before publication.
We aim to keep product, price and availability information accurate. Details may change, and an order is subject to confirmation, stock availability and successful payment.

Submitting checkout information creates an order request through Odoo. Noel's may contact the customer if an item is unavailable, information is incomplete or an order cannot be fulfilled. Payment methods are those shown at checkout.

An online prescription submission is a request for pharmacist review. It is not a diagnosis, medical advice, confirmation of stock or automatic approval to dispense. Additional information, an original document, identification or an in-person visit may be requested where necessary.
Prices and promotions shown on the website apply under their displayed conditions and may differ from earlier or expired offers. Obvious errors may be corrected before fulfilment.

Available fulfilment options are shown during checkout or confirmed by staff. Customers should wait for a ready notice before collection. Return eligibility depends on product type, condition and applicable health and safety requirements.
Do not attempt to misuse the website, submit false information, upload harmful files, access another person's records or interfere with the service.
Website content is for general information only and does not replace individual advice from a pharmacist, doctor or qualified health professional.
Questions about these terms may be submitted through the contact page or by calling .
